text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes, the first targeted 
race where she had declared victory. On 
race day, Tokyo Racecourse was wrapped in 
a restless, buoyant buzz.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder, Smart Falcon. You're not going 
to stumble right at the start, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... She was strong last year, sure, but 
not quite "the strongest" tier.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Btw, I think this might be my first time 
watching a dirt race. I'm honestly getting 
hyped for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The electric atmosphere of the venue 
carried over to Smart Falcon in the 
waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder how high we can aim.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know, the Tokyo Racecourse is where 
they hold the Japanese Derby, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The wildly popular turf race, the Japan 
Derby. Only Classic-tier runners are 
permitted to challenge it, and many bet 
their dreams on it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the Derby on par with the Arima 
Kinen... no, maybe it's even more hyped 
up?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how close Falco and the others 
can get to that excitement...
choice_data_list: That's one hell of a high wall.
That's one hell of a high wall, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know. The Derby is super special! Right 
now, no matter how much I run, I still 
can't catch up.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, we've certainly gathered enough 
attention!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I take 1st place today, maybe the next 
race will feel a little special!
choice_data_list: All that's left is to keep on winning.
All that's left is to keep on winning.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If you lose right from the start, 
there's no point to anything.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I have to win and keep people talking. So 
I can be smiling on that year-end stage—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm gonna get off to the best start 
possible!”
